summary: Frontend-only test of Phase-28 Cmd-K Command Palette as principal@vaagdevi.edu.in. All 8 critical UX requirements verified end-to-end: FAB visible (md+) with Search + ⌘K kbd; palette opens via Ctrl+K (Linux Playwright) and via FAB click; cmdk-input focused; cmdk-list mounted; fuzzy filter works; ArrowDown+Enter selects + closes + navigates + persists to localStorage academiaos.cmdk.recent; Recent group appears at the top of the list on reopen with cmdk-recent-* testids; Escape closes without navigating; palette is mounted globally (verified on /admissions and /placements). Cumulative backend remains 156/156 from prior iterations.

issues: Radix a11y warning: `DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.` Also `Missing Description or aria-describedby`. Wrap a visually-hidden <DialogTitle>Command Palette</DialogTitle> (or pass aria-label) inside CommandDialog to silence and improve screen-reader UX.

spec_deviations.spec: Type 'nexus' — at least 3 items must remain visible
spec_deviations.actual: Only 2 items match: 'NEXUS · Campus ERP' (/nexus) and 'NEXUS Console' (/nexus-console). cmdk filters by item.value which includes label + group; no other DESTINATIONS contain the substring 'nexus', so 2 is the correct technical result. The spec's '...and possibly Student Services items' is misleading — cmdk does not surface non-matching group siblings.
spec_deviations.suggested_fix: If the spec truly needs >=3 hits, augment each item's `value` with synonyms/keywords (e.g. include 'erp campus students' for /nexus-console) or relax the spec to >=2. Functional behaviour is correct.

spec_deviations.actual: Implementation uses `cmdk-item${path.replace(/\//g,'-')}` (no explicit dash between prefix and path). Dashboard '/' yields `cmdk-item-`; '/nexus' yields `cmdk-item-nexus`. Recent items yield e.g. `cmdk-recent--nexus-console` (double dash). The current testids still satisfy `[data-testid^='cmdk-item']` and `[data-testid^='cmdk-recent-']` selectors so tests pass, but readability is poor.

action_items: (Optional, low) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle + Description to CommandDialog to clear Radix a11y warnings.
(Optional, low) Either expand item.value with keywords so 'nexus' yields >=3 matches, or update the spec/test contract to expect >=2 NEXUS items.
(Optional, cosmetic) Normalize data-testid concatenation to avoid double-dashes in cmdk-recent-* / leading-dashes in cmdk-item-*.
critical_code_review_comments: CommandPalette.jsx is self-contained, ~180 LOC, follows DRY — DESTINATIONS array is the single source of truth and is intentionally kept in sync with App.js routes (developer must remember to update both — consider deriving from a shared route manifest later).
Keyboard handler correctly preventDefaults Cmd/Ctrl+K (avoids the browser search shortcut) and uses functional setState updater (race-free).
loadRecent/pushRecent use try/catch and cap recent list to 6 entries — good.
Group rendering uses Object.entries which is insertion-ordered in modern JS — fine for the current DESTINATIONS layout but document the assumption.
FAB hidden on mobile (md:flex) per spec — keyboard shortcut still works on mobile keyboards though, which is good.
No business-logic regression on Shell.jsx — CommandPalette is mounted once at the bottom of the authenticated shell, available on every route.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical CMDK requirements; 6/8 strict-spec assertions, 2 minor over-specifications (see spec_deviations)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-28 Cmd-K palette is functionally complete and working. The only outstanding items are (a) Radix a11y DialogTitle warning and (b) interpretation of 'nexus -> 3 results' clause in the spec (technically 2 matches). Tests were run from Linux Playwright using Control+K (palette also responds to Meta+K). FAB requires viewport width >= 768px (md). Use localStorage key 'academiaos.cmdk.recent' to inspect recent state.
